provenance: Synthetic. Written for this repository from the published structure of the form and the ordinary shape of departmental practice. No client matter, no real GSTIN, no real taxpayer, officer or reference number. Written so the extended-period allegation is the operative question, which is what a Section 74 notice actually turns on.
description: A Section 74 demand alleging suppression. The turnover limb is substantially correct on the figures but the invocation of the extended period is not made out on the notice's own findings; the blocked-credit limb is a straightforward concession.
notice_text:
FORM GST DRC-01
[See rule 142(1)(a)]
Summary of Show Cause Notice

Reference No : ZD270625117733        Date : 20/06/2025

GSTIN : 27AAGCK9182L1ZH
Name : M/s. KALPATARU TEXTILE MILLS PRIVATE LIMITED
Address : GALA 7, MIDC BUTIBORI, NAGPUR - 441122

Tax Period : FY 2019-20
Section under which notice is issued : 74
Date by which reply has to be submitted : 21/07/2025

Whereas it appears that tax has not been paid by reason of wilful
misstatement and suppression of facts with intent to evade payment of
tax, you are called upon to show cause why the amounts below should not
be demanded under Section 74 of the Act along with interest and penalty
equal to the tax so determined.

Summary of tax and other dues proposed

   Particulars                                   CGST           SGST         IGST       CESS           Total
   Total demand                          356,250.00    356,250.00          0.00          0.00      712,500.00

1. Difference in turnover suppressed from the returns

   Turnover recorded in the books seized during the visit does not appear in the returns filed for the corresponding period. The omission is alleged to be wilful and Section 74 is invoked.

   Particulars                                   CGST           SGST         IGST       CESS           Total
   Difference                            312,500.00    312,500.00          0.00          0.00      625,000.00

2. Ineligible ITC availed on blocked credit under Section 17(5)

   Credit has been availed on food and beverages and on club membership charges, both of which are blocked under Section 17(5).

   Particulars                                   CGST           SGST         IGST       CESS           Total
   Difference                             43,750.00     43,750.00          0.00          0.00       87,500.00

You may appear for a personal hearing on the date that will be
communicated separately.

Proper Officer
Name : S V DESHPANDE
Designation : Deputy Commissioner of State Tax
Jurisdiction : NAGPUR DIVISION , NAGPUR , Maharashtra

intake.issues:
1. Difference in turnover suppressed from the returns
2. Ineligible ITC availed on blocked credit under Section 17(5)
intake.facts: Textile mill. The turnover was recorded in the books throughout and was reported in the annual return, though omitted from the monthly returns of two quarters. The omission was disclosed by the taxpayer's own auditor before the visit. The blocked credit is admitted.
intake.documents_available: Audited accounts, annual return, monthly returns, auditor's qualification recording the omission, expense ledgers for the blocked credit

defects.heading: Difference in turnover suppressed from the returns
Ineligible ITC availed on blocked credit under Section 17(5)

expected.outcome: Section 74 was held not to be made out. The demand was re-determined under Section 73 and penalty restricted accordingly.
expected.notes: Turnover disclosed in the books and in the annual return cannot found an allegation of suppression. Attacking the section, not the arithmetic, is what moves this matter.

required_evidence_that_was_missing: The auditor's qualification and the working papers recording the omission before the departmental visit
